name: Remove Clipchamp
description: Removes Microsoft Clipchamp from your system if it is installed, freeing up storage and removing an unused app.

description_i18n.en: Removes Microsoft Clipchamp from your system if it is installed, freeing up storage and removing an unused app.
description_i18n.de: Entfernt Microsoft Clipchamp von deinem System, falls installiert. Freit Speicherplatz und entfernt eine ungenutzte App.
description_i18n.fr: Supprime Microsoft Clipchamp de ton système s'il est installé, libérant l'espace et retirant une application inutilisée.

warnings.title: App removal confirmation
warnings.message: This action permanently deletes the Clipchamp application from your device. You will not be able to use it again without reinstalling it manually.

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Removes installed and provisioned Appx packages matching 'Clipchamp'. The script removes both user-installed instances and system-wide provisioning entries.
